label: D1 after an unrewarded trial while the agent leans moderately toward a2
explanation: Fires only at D1 (100% of mass; never at GO or D2). 90% of mass comes when the previous trial was unrewarded (reward input 0), and nearly all of it when the upcoming choice is a2 (0 activations before a1 choices). When the previous trial is known, it was almost always a2 then a rare transition to S1 (prev_common=0 & prev_action=2: 82% of mass, 5 cases otherwise), and the hidden good state is usually S2. Its activations bunch together in a mid band of the D1 policy logit (choice between -8.9 and -4.4: 90% of mass) and of value (7.1 to 7.5), and in episode trials 20 to 60. Magnitude builds over runs of consecutive unrewarded a2 trials in the top windows (e.g. 0.68, 0.87, 0.96, 0.99). The recorded predicate uses only observed variables plus the model policy logit: D1, previous trial unrewarded, choice logit between -8 and -5 (dev F1 0.57, recall 0.89, precision 0.42). Using prev_state in {S1, unknown} together with action==2 instead of the logit gives the same recall at lower precision (F1 0.35). Precision is incomplete: many D1 steps after unrewarded a2 trials, which look the same on these variables, stay below threshold, and the ep_trial dependence is not explained.
